audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart had all seven rows Xerath while content, the packet chart, and every content why say Vex — the lane is a range-vs-all-in war Vex wins once Shocking Orb is baited.
audit.why: 50.06% WR, packet levelChart all Vex, content whys all describe Vex holding the commit.
audit.corrected: Flipped full sides to Vex with whys rewritten to the real dynamic.

audit.why: Spikes: 3-5 orb-bait window, 6 Shadow Surge gap-close, first item burst, late flank. All grounded.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeGood/dosFull/dontsFull built on Xerath 'answering with a dash' — Xerath has no dash; his only defense is the Shocking Orb stun (13s at rank 1). Content correctly centers the orb; full layer did not.
audit.why: Kit: Xerath E 13s CD, hardCC, projectile (blocked by minions); Q 750 range, W 1000, R channel-flagged and cancellable by fear.
audit.corrected: Rewrote trades around orb-baiting, minion cover vs his E, and cooldown gaps in his Q/W cycle.
Added E 13s, Q 9-5s, W 14-10s, own W 16s, R 140s.

edits.before: E-mark the contact, Q through the marked line for the fear, auto, walk — every trade he answers with a dash just schedules the next fear.
edits.after: Bait Shocking Orb with a feint step, then trade E-Q — the stun is 13s at rank 1, and without it his artillery never converts into a kill.

edits.before: Spending the W pulse on poke spacing and then eating the real engage unfeared — the pulse is the matchup against everything that moves fast.
edits.after: Walking straight lines through his Q-W poke to force a trade — he out-ranges you at 750-1000 and wins any exchange taken at his max range.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Personal Space for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining, 13s at rank 1 — his only CC; dodge it and the artillery never converts a kill. - Q cycles 9-5s, W 14-10s: step up in the gaps. - Your W (16s) is for emergencies, the R (140s) for opportunities.

edits.before: Mark and bolt — your trades are honest and your passive makes his mobility dishonest. Bank Gloom procs like currency.
edits.after: Hide behind minions — Shocking Orb cannot reach you through them, and his Q-W poke is telegraphed enough to side-step.

edits.before: You are the engage tax: their dive comp feeds your fears, your R feeds on their commitments, and the carry they sent dies mid-dash, repeatedly.
edits.after: One flank ends him: R-E from fog, fear the peel, and he dies before the barrage turns — never eat his poke standing still in fights.

edits.before: E-mark the contact, Q through the marked line for the fear, auto, walk — every trade he answers with a dash just schedules the next fear.
edits.after: With Doom up, a feared Q locks the dashless Xerath in place — he cannot walk out of your E zone, so the whole rotation lands unanswered.

edits.before: The pulse answers exactly one engage per cooldown — spent on spacing, the next dash arrives to a quiet, fearless, dead Vex.
edits.after: The pulse answers exactly one commit per cooldown — spend it on spacing and the next gank lands on a quiet, fearless, dead Vex.

edits.before: Spending the W pulse on poke spacing and then eating the real engage unfeared — the pulse is the matchup against everything that moves fast.
edits.after: Never trade while his E is up — eating Shocking Orb into a full Q-W-R barrage is how his poke lane turns into a kill lane in one window.
